A CRS In Focus report updated 2026-08-28 lists nine voting members and two ex officio members, none of them HUD, and reports no enacted membership change. A presidential memorandum of 2025-02-21 states an aim of protecting farmland and real estate near sensitive facilities and assigns implementation to the Treasury Secretary, a parallel step that does not mention HUD. CFIUS real estate jurisdiction remains limited to property near certain military installations, ports and airports.
